title: Canonical public-comparison and reproducibility pack register for protected M5 benchmark claims
summary: Binds every publication pack in the benchmark-governance matrix to one reproducibility pack that carries the raw configuration, exact commands, corpus and revision refs, reference-hardware and lab-image identity, environment notes, caveats, raw-run-metadata refs, and reproduction recipe an independent reviewer reruns or audits against, and exposes the pack ids docs, help, release, and procurement surfaces cite instead of rephrasing benchmark context by hand.
